selection_rule.declarer_continuation: first declarer card-play decision after the opening lead with more than one legal card
selection_rule.defense_continuation: first defender card-play decision after the opening lead with more than one legal card
selection_rule.fallback: only if requested family is unavailable

blindness_contract.allowed_information: auction, contract, vulnerability, own remaining hand, exposed dummy when applicable, completed/public play history, current trick, legal cards
blindness_contract.prediction_requirement: choose exactly one legal card per task before opening the sealed labels or running DDS
